title: 6 homes struck by gunfire after more than 30 rounds fired in Coatesville neighborhood
text:
Six homes and four cars were struck by gunfire Tuesday night in a Coatesville neighborhood. Police say all of the homes were occupied at the time of the shooting, but no injuries have been reported.
Police in Chester County have launched an investigation after half a dozen homes were struck by gunfire late Tuesday night. Investigators say all of the homes were occupied at the time of the shooting. Coatesville Police were called to Community Lane around 11:30 p.m. Tuesday for a report of multiple shots fired. When police arrived, they found that more than 30 shots had been fired in the area. A total of six occupied homes were struck by gunfire, as well as four cars that were unoccupied.
